description_en: Queries the monitoring data of snapshot size changes within the last 30 days in a region
description_zh: 查询一个地域下近30天内的快照容量变化监控数据
name: DescribeSnapshotMonitorData

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query snapshot size change data. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取快照容量变化数据的起始时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是 00，则自动换算为下一分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query snapshot size change data. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is automatically rounded up to the next minute
parameters.help_zh: 获取快照容量变化数据的结束时间点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是 00，则自动换算为下一分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which to query snapshot size change data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

60
600
3600

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
获取快照容量变化数据的间隔时间，单位为秒。取值范围：

60
600
3600

默认值：60
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot type. Valid values:

Standard: standard snapshot.
Flash: local snapshot.
Archive: archive snapshot.

Default value: Standard
parameters.help_zh:
快照类型。取值范围：

Standard：标准快照。
Flash：本地快照。
Archive：归档快照。

默认值：Standard
parameters.name: category
